225:t_000:60.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry for worrying you, $$アルト$$.」

225:t_000:61.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry about it. We're friends, right?」

225:t_001:0.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain! A message from the $$バトル７$$ outside the atmosphere! A $$バジュラ$$ swarm is descending toward the ruins!」

225:t_001:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We've confirmed it here too! A swarm broke through the $$バトル７$$'s defensive line and is heading our way!」

225:t_002:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That color...! They're the same as the ones from last time!」

225:t_002:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「We can speculate later! They're attacking!」

225:t_003:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Those $$バジュラ$$ seem to be targeting the ruins!」

225:t_003:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「What's going on!? Why would they do that!?」

225:t_003:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$, $$ガムリン$$, $n! Leave this to us and head for the ruins!」

225:t_003:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Gather as much information as possible before they destroy the ruins!」

225:t_004:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, intercept the $$バジュラ$$. Keep them away from the ruins.」

225:t_004:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「To all units! We're setting the defensive line as follows!」

225:t_005:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If they cross that line, they'll be able to attack the ruins directly.」

225:t_005:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Then we simply have to strike them before that.」

225:t_005:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「With $$熱気バサラ$$ absent, do we have no choice but to fight...?」

225:t_005:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin your attack! Hold out until the survey team returns!」

225:t_005:5.en:
$$オズマ$$
(I'm counting on you to protect $$ランカ$$, $$アルト$$, $$ブレラ$$...!)

225:t_006:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Tch! They're firing like crazy!」

225:t_006:1.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Those ruins... Do they mean something to the $$バジュラ$$ too...!?」

225:t_008:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「They're close to the ruins!」

225:t_009:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you all right, $$アルト$$!?」

225:t_009:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「This is $$ガムリン・木崎$$! $$バサラ$$ was injured by a collapsing wall! Prepare to take him aboard immediately!」

225:t_009:3.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I'm sorry, $$バサラ$$... You protected me...」

225:t_009:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't... worry about it... More importantly... I'm gonna sing...」

225:t_009:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you saying!? Get back here, $$バサラ$$!」

225:t_009:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Shut up! I said... I'm gonna sing!」

225:t_010:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「That idiot...! He's going to sing to the $$バジュラ$$...!?」

225:t_010:1.en:
$$ランカ$$
「$$アルト$$! I... I'm going to sing...!」

225:t_010:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I was born to do something too...! I'm here to convey something...! So...!」

225:t_013:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Is it the power of her song...?」

225:t_013:2.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「But it feels different from before...」

225:t_013:4.en:
$$シュレード$$
(Did $$ミコノ$$'s power to connect sense something flowing through $$ランカ$$'s song...?)

225:t_013:7.en:
$$ランカ$$
(What is this...? There are still sadness and doubts somewhere in my heart, but little by little, they're fading...)

225:t_013:8.en:
$$ランカ$$
(If I keep singing, then surely, someday...)

225:t_013:12.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It hurts a little, but I feel a lot better than I did before.」

225:t_013:13.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Is it because of $$ランカ$$'s song...?」

225:t_013:15.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Be careful! Something else is coming!」

225:t_014:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The type used by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$!?」

225:t_014:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Come to think of it, during the $$時獄戦役$$, $$アルテア$$'s $$ミカゲ$$ summoned $$ゴーストＶ９$$s along with the $$バジュラ$$...!」

225:t_014:3.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Then is the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ with the $$バジュラ$$!?」

225:t_014:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, shoot down the $$ゴースト$$s and gather as much information as possible!」

225:t_014:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$! Leave the rest to us!」

225:t_015:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If we're fighting machines, I'll take them on! $$バサラ$$, stay back!」

225:t_015:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$惑星ラクス$$ holds memories for me too. Of course I'm fired up on a planet like it.」

225:t_015:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go! From here on, this is my stage!」

225:t_016:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「The $$バトル７$$ appears to still be engaged in combat.」

225:t_016:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Depending on the situation, we'll head over to assist too. Order all units to return.」

225:t_016:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アルト$$... What about the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins...?」

225:t_016:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Unfortunately, the ruins were destroyed, but we obtained some information about the end of the universe.」

context_decisions: Battle proceeds with ruins team inside and defensive line outside; Basara injured protecting Mylene, then Ranka sings. Singing heals Basara and repels Vajra; subsequent enemies are machines.
Ray speaker resolved as Fire Bomber Ray (#pt231) by scene cast, despite ambiguous options and shifted pid.
